svg.title: Time per node: latency bound, then bandwidth bound
svg.desc: Log-log plot of the time per cache line fetch against the number k of independent fetches in flight, for L = 140 ns, bandwidth 16 bytes per ns and at most 12 fetches in flight. The time falls as L/k until k = 12 (11.7 ns), where the hardware limit stops it, far above the bandwidth floor of 4 ns that would need k = 35.
svg.text: Time per node: latency bound, then bandwidth bound
L = 140 ns beta = 16 bytes/ns M = 12 lines in flight (illustrative values)
k, independent fetches in flight (log scale)
